title: Servo Angle and Pulse Width Explorer
description: Set a pulse width in microseconds and watch the servo arm swing to the angle it encodes.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Chapter 17: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a target pulse width in microseconds, the learner calculates the resulting servo angle using the standard pulse-to-angle formula.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Pulse-width slider driving a rotating arm, with the formula substituted live
pedagogical.assessment: Ask for the pulse width that moves the arm a quarter turn from centre.
